description: Phase 2 features: Enhanced admin matching tools, member statistics dashboard, announcements/business rooms, and monthly report generation
steps: 1. Add announcements/business rooms feature: Add a new 'announcements' table to convex/schema.ts with fields: authorId (Id<members>), title, body, category (union: notice/promotion/bizroom), pinned (boolean), status (active/archived), createdAt. Add indexes by_category and by_created.

2. Create convex/announcements.ts with CRUD functions: list (filter by category, paginated), create (admin only for notices, any active member for promotion/bizroom), archive (admin or author), get (single). Include author summary projection.

3. Create src/pages/AnnouncementsPage.tsx with category tabs (notice/promotion/bizroom), card list with author info, and creation form (admin sees all categories, member sees promotion/bizroom only). Add route '/community' in App.tsx.
4. Add community tab to bottom navigation in src/components/Layout.tsx replacing or adding alongside existing tabs. Use Megaphone icon from lucide-react.

5. Add member personal statistics: Create a new query in convex/members.ts called 'myStats' that returns: total connections made (accepted), total requests posted, total matches completed (as helper), contribution breakdown by type, and profile views count (approximate via a simple counter). For the initial version, derive from existing data without adding a new table.

6. Add a stats section to MyProfilePage showing: connections count, requests posted, times helped (matches where I'm helper with status done), total contribution points breakdown. Use the existing StatCard component.

7. Enhance admin matching workflow: In the AdminOverview, add a quick-match section that shows the top 3 open requests with the best recommended helper for each (pre-computed from recommendForRequest). Admin can one-click propose the recommended helper.

8. Add member export/summary for admin: Create a query 'admin.memberSummary' that returns CSV-friendly data (name, phone, company, cohort, university, industry, region, status, contribution score, createdAt). Add a 'Download CSV' button in AdminMembers component that generates a CSV file client-side from this data.
9. Update the Home page to show an announcements preview section (latest 2 notices/promotions) with a link to the full /community page.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
Announcements schema table exists with proper indexes
AnnouncementsPage renders with category tabs and creation form
Community tab appears in bottom navigation
Admin overview has quick-match one-click section
Admin members has CSV export button
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/ROTConnector && pnpm build' and confirm exit code 0
findings: Updated convex/_generated/api.d.ts to register the new announcements module (standard Convex workflow when adding new backend modules). Used timeAgo() instead of formatDate() for announcement timestamps since createdAt is a number (epoch ms) not a date string. The FunctionReturnType pattern from convex/server is the correct way to type query results in components.
